meta.source: Waiheke Backyards Solutions brand asset pack (WBS Brand Guide, May 2026)

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: PRIMARY, 60% of the brand. Headlines, body text and the mark on bone or paper (10.6:1); the ground of reverse layouts, the footer and the Forest theme.

tokens.name: timber
tokens.usage: ACCENT, 10%. The sun disc on the mark, primary buttons, rules and marks. Not for text under 24px on bone or paper (2.8:1) nor on forest (3.8:1); use timber-text for those.

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: SURFACE, 30%. Section and card grounds in the Bone theme; text and mark on forest in reverse layouts (10.6:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground behind bone sections. Forest reads 11.2:1 on it.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: MONO. The mono logo variants and pure black-on-bone print work only; never mixed with forest in one layout.

tokens.name: coastal
tokens.usage: OPTIONAL. Duotone photography (Coastal × Bone) and large numerals only; 3.9:1 on bone, so never small text.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers, input borders on bone and paper. Decorative, carries no meaning.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground per theme: paper in Bone, forest in Forest.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating sections and cards. In Forest a step lighter than forest; ink reads 8.4:1 on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs and hovered cards. Bordered with line, never a shadow.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All headlines and body copy on surface, surface-alt and surface-raised (10.6:1 and up in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions, footer meta on surface and surface-alt (6.0:1 Bone, 5.8:1 Forest). The guide's forest at 60–70% opacity, flattened.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders and dividers per theme.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Text-weight brand colour per theme: links, the mark, the wordmark.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text on a brand fill (10.6:1 both themes).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Timber as a fill: primary buttons, the sun disc, chips, progress. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a timber fill, 3.8:1: only for button labels at 16px 600 or larger, as the guide's cards do. For small text on timber use charcoal-free alternatives: put the text beside the fill instead.

tokens.name: timber-text
tokens.usage: INTENTIONAL ADDITION: timber darkened (Bone, 4.8:1 on bone) or lightened (Forest, 6.2:1 on forest) so DM Mono eyebrows and small labels in the accent colour meet 4.5:1. The guide sets those in timber itself, which reads 2.8:1; keep timber for marks and fills.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid timber with a 2px surface gap. 3.8:1 on forest, 2.8:1 on bone: so on bone the ring is doubled with a 1px forest inner line (see README).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Quote sent, job booked. Always with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Weather or ferry delay notices. Same values as timber-text; always with a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors (6.1:1 on bone, 6.4:1 on forest). Always with a message.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline on desktop, one per page. Tracking −3%, leading 1.0, as the guide's Display.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Process steps, FAQ questions, form legends.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Decks, fences, retaining walls and small builds across Waiheke Island.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A 30% deposit confirms the booking and reserves materials.
styles.usage: Paragraphs, lists, inputs. Line-height 1.5 as the guide's Body.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Workmanship warranted for 12 months from completion.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above titles, section numbers, in timber-text or ink-muted. Tracking +22% as the guide's Utility.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Phone numbers, dates, prices, reference codes. Uppercase, tracking +4%.

styles.name: mono-l
styles.usage: Large utility lines: a phone number in the CTA band, stats.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, wordmark line gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Input padding, stacked text gap, eyebrow-to-title margin.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Mark-to-wordmark gap in the horizontal lockup at scale 1.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones, grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Title-to-content gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop (the guide's tiles).

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Grid gap between columns in the guide's spreads; section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Logo clear space: the mark's own height around every lockup.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Desktop side margin.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, swatches, business cards: the guide's one radius.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles and image frames.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: Favicon and app-icon rounded square, iOS-friendly.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Business cards and lifted image tiles only. Web cards use a line border instead.

tokens.name: shadow-inset-line
tokens.usage: Hairline inset on bone tiles and swatches.

logo.note: Sizing and clear space from the guide's section 04.

tokens.name: logo-min-digital
tokens.usage: Minimum width of the horizontal lockup on screen.

tokens.name: logo-min-print
tokens.usage: Minimum width of the horizontal lockup in print.

tokens.name: mark-min
tokens.usage: Minimum size of the isolated mark (8mm in print).

tokens.name: mark-nav
tokens.usage: Mark size in the site header.
